name: Job Monitoring
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/features).
*   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Input Data: One PR (hotwax/oms#764) - "Added conditions to show release icon when jobs are older than system start time i.e. crashed."
*   Target Structure:
    *   New Features/Enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact (3-4 sentences).
    *   Bug Fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]." (1 sentence).
*   Style Guide Constraints:
    *   Simpler is better.
    *   Active voice.
    *   Granular but concise.
    *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
    *   **No "AI Slop"**: No "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    *   **No Exclamation Points**: Use only periods.
    *   **No "dev-time bugs"**: Don't mention bugs/fixes for new features.
    *   **True Bug Fixes**: Start with "Fixed a bug...".
*   Cluster Content: Visual markers (icons) to identify jobs that crashed or failed to restart (based on job age vs. system start time).
